description: Codex Factory External Engine Registry v2 — security, performance, UI E2E, and reader engines

engines.description: Static analysis security testing for multiple languages
engines.skip_condition: semgrep not in PATH or pip not available
engines.evidence_binding_policy: ALWAYS_BIND — security findings must enter evidence binding
non_claims: CLEAN result does not mean bug-free or secure
False negatives exist in all static analysis tools
Not a replacement for manual security review

engines.description: HTTP load testing tool for API smoke tests
engines.skip_condition: Service not running, port mismatch, or module resolution blocks server start
engines.evidence_binding_policy: BIND_WITH_NON_CLAIMS — results are local smoke only, not production capacity
non_claims: Local smoke test only — NOT production capacity proof
Results are dev-machine measurements, not reproducible benchmarks
Does NOT prove million-concurrency capability
Single-endpoint smoke != system-wide performance test

engines.description: Browser automation for UI smoke tests and E2E validation
engines.skip_condition: No UI surface, no playwright config in project, browser version mismatch
engines.evidence_binding_policy: BIND_WHEN_RUN — UI smoke evidence for surface validation
non_claims: UI smoke is NOT comprehensive E2E testing
Does NOT cover all browser/device combinations
API-only projects should not be blocked by Playwright unavailability

engines.description: GitHub CodeQL — deep semantic code analysis and variant analysis
engines.run_command_template: codeql database create {db_path} --language={lang} --source-root={target_path} && codeql database analyze {db_path} --format=sarif-latest --output={output_file}
engines.skip_condition: codeql CLI not installed; requires 'codeql bundle' download or GitHub Actions runner
engines.evidence_binding_policy: BIND_WHEN_AVAILABLE — CodeQL is heavy; skip acceptable if documented
non_claims: CodeQL not installed on this machine — requires manual setup
Install: download from github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries
Heavy analysis — not suitable for quick validation smoke
engines.install_instructions: Download CodeQL CLI bundle from https://github.com/github/codeql-action/releases, extract, add to PATH, then run 'codeql version'

engines.description: Grafana k6 — modern load testing tool with JavaScript scripting
engines.skip_condition: k6 CLI not installed; requires chocolatey/brew/download
engines.evidence_binding_policy: BIND_WITH_NON_CLAIMS — structured load test, still not production capacity proof
non_claims: k6 not installed on this machine — requires manual setup
Install: choco install k6 (Windows), brew install k6 (macOS), or download from grafana.com
Load test results are dev-environment measurements
Does NOT constitute production capacity certification
engines.install_instructions: choco install k6 (Windows, admin) or download from https://grafana.com/docs/k6/latest/set-up/install-k6/

engines.description: Firecrawl — web page reader and content extractor. READER ONLY — NOT canonical search.
engines.install_detection: Check for FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable or npm @mendable/firecrawl-js
engines.skip_condition: No FIRECRAWL_API_KEY set, npm package not installed, or URL unreachable
non_claims: NOT canonical search — Firecrawl is a reader/extractor only
Does NOT replace /api/paas/v4/web_search pipeline
Evidence from Firecrawl must be marked source_origin=firecrawl_reader
Cannot be used to generate canonical Evidence Packs
API key required — not available without user configuration
Content extraction quality depends on target page structure
engines.install_instructions: npm install @mendable/firecrawl-js; set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable
